name: South Carolina
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); state policy baseline is Section 508 (2004 AOC policy), and the ASCIT program recommends WCAG 2.0 AA and encourages 2.1 AA

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: State agencies (AOC policy); SC.GOV says each state agency and local government is responsible for its own compliance.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Section 508 minimum for state agency websites (2004 AOC policy, per secondary source)
Agency-level accessibility policies; for example SCDOR targets WCAG 2.1 AA
mobile: not addressed — state policy predates mobile; only the federal rule covers them.
procurement: No statewide accessibility procurement clause found.
enforcement: SC.GOV portal issues go to support@scgov.atlassian.net or Relay SC; otherwise agency-level; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The June 2004 State Architecture Oversight Committee policy (Section 508 minimum, WCAG as best practice) is known only from secondary search results and was not opened. accessibility.sc.gov returned 502. No SC statute found.
